name: Photato
subtitle: Native image editing for Mac
promotionalText: A free native image editor, built with AI-aided development. This alpha is unfinished: many planned features are unavailable and compatibility is still being tested.
description:
Photato is a native image editor for Mac, written in Swift. It brings a familiar desktop workspace to an independent, free and open-source project.

ALPHA SOFTWARE
This is an early alpha, not a finished professional editor. Much planned functionality is not yet available. Some tools, file conversions and rendering results remain incomplete, and full compatibility with other editors has not been established. Save copies of important work and retain your original files.

EXPLORE THE CURRENT EDITOR
• Build compositions with layers, groups, masks and selections.
• Paint, retouch and adjust colour using native editing controls.
• Work with editable text, shapes, fills and document guides.
• Save native Photato projects and try supported image formats, including developing PSD and PSB workflows.
• Automate supported operations through an optional local API.

OPTIONAL APPLE AI
On eligible Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 26 or later, Photato can use available Apple Intelligence features. Availability depends on your Mac, system settings, language, region and downloaded models. Apple image-generation services may use Private Cloud Compute on supported systems and require an internet connection. AI is optional; ordinary editing does not require it.

BUILT WITH AI-AIDED DEVELOPMENT
Photato is a practical demonstration of what AI-aided software development can build. Its development diary records the source port, implementation decisions, tests, failures and remaining gaps. This alpha demonstrates that progress; it does not claim complete functionality or parity with established professional applications.

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
No purchases, subscriptions, tips or paid feature unlocks. The repository will become public on the same day the software is released.

Photato is an independent native Swift fork and port of PhotoCraft by the ArtCraft Team and contributors, under MIT OR Apache-2.0. It is not affiliated with Adobe or endorsed by the PhotoCraft upstream project.

macOS 14 or later. Apple Silicon and Intel builds are included; supported-system qualification is still in progress.
